sales_calculation.definition: Sales of a day = sum of sales_invoice.grand_total (GST inclusive) of POSTED invoices with that invoice_date. DRAFT, DISCARDED and CANCELLED are excluded. Credit notes and returns are NOT deducted (gross sales).

outstanding_balance.definition: Invoice paid = sum of receivable_allocation.amount not undone; balance = grand_total - paid; open while above zero. Opening bills likewise. Customer outstanding = open invoice and opening-bill balances - unallocated_amount of POSTED receipts (advances) - unapplied_amount of POSTED credit notes.

stock_calculation.definition: Stock = stock_balance.quantity_on_hand per warehouse (all batches, expired included, not_for_sale warehouses included). Low stock = an active reorder_rule whose warehouse holds at most min_qty (base unit).

customer_count_definition.definition: Customers = customer rows of the company that are not cash-sale placeholders (cash_sale), counted active and inactive. Customers billed in a period = different customer_id of POSTED sales_invoice rows dated in it with counter_sale false; counter-sale invoices are counted as bills only (they name no customer). Login users are not customers and are never counted.
